title: CAN 14 · real camera clips of the held-out runs

run.note: The run the clip shows; joins samples.json's run.

situation.note: Always real: there is no sim picture of the rack.

src.note: The clip, relative to this file.

t0.note: Clock time (the run's t) at frame 0: the grid starts 0.3 s before the run's first sample, so ≈ −0.3. Frame k is at t0 + k / fps, by construction of the resample.

fps.note: The resample grid's rate (the camera's nominal 30).

duration.note: frames ÷ fps: the run plus 0.3 s each side.

max_stamp_gap_s.note: The farthest any output frame's picture is from its grid time (camera drops). The camera's own capture-to-stamp latency is not measured.

rows.note: Camera 218622274411 (RealSense, 30 fps nominal), 1040 recorded frames resampled to a uniform 30 fps grid (58 grid frames reuse their neighbour's picture); cropped to the left plate, brightened (gamma 0.5), CAN 14's tag boxed in orange from the 10-24 tag detection. Real footage, not a render.
